component.name: Murmur
component.summary: Private voice dictation for your panel

description.p: Murmur puts voice dictation in your COSMIC panel. Hold Right Alt, say what you want to write, and let go. Your words are typed into whatever window you are using, with punctuation and capitals.
Speech recognition runs entirely on your computer using NVIDIA Parakeet. Nothing you say leaves your machine, and there is no account, no subscription and no GPU required.

ul.li: Push-to-talk on Right Alt or any key you choose
Types into any app, with punctuation and capitals
Fast on-device transcription, typically under half a second
Live level meter in the panel while you speak
Recent dictations one click from the clipboard
Word replacements for names and jargon
Recovers on its own when keyboards, microphones or the engine drop out

screenshot.caption: The panel applet: status, recent dictations and quick controls
Settings: hotkey, speech model, sounds and word replacements

ul.li: Push-to-talk dictation typed into the focused window
On-device Parakeet speech models, English and multilingual
